_doc.purpose: Named demand scenarios read by assets/build_demand.py and by the sim. veh_h is vehicles per hour per boundary approach; scale multiplies veh_h and burst_mult.
_doc.scale_bursts: when true, scale also lengthens platoons (gridlock needs both more cars and tighter bursts).
_doc.verdict: what the validation harness should see, not what the generator assumes.

baseline.verdict: free-flowing: vehicles arrive, mean speed > 4 m/s, nothing sticks past 60 s

platoon.verdict: queues form and drain: mean speed 2-5 m/s, some stalls 60-120 s, no permanent block

gridlock.verdict: backed up grid: stalls persist and mean speed drops under 3 m/s
